note: Concession-run campground (The REEF LLC) on Crab Orchard Lake in the national wildlife refuge, near Carbondale. Loop A runs along the north shore, loop B sits on a peninsula by the swim beach, and loop E fills an open grassy point at the west end. Lakeside sites are in loop A's south row, on loop B's west side and around loop E; the shore there is riprap. Camp store with bait, fish cleaning station, kayak rentals. --Claude
